alt: Table of what the GTA 6 stash bag glitch pays: Insider Gaming says the starting value is added each pickup, Insider Gaming and Game Rant say about 8 to 12 pickups, VICE got $277,200 in one bag and says a full van is about $2.72 million, one player claims $700,000 for two jewelry bags.
